## Changes
- Live captions: show them in a floating, translucent window while you record, with each line marked Me or Others. Turn it on in Settings → General (or the menu bar's Live captions submenu), pick its colour and transparency, then drag and resize it anywhere. - Recording: fixed a likely cause of Ahoy quitting in the middle of a recording when a headset switches modes, for example when a Teams call ends. - Keep audio: "Delete after transcription" no longer deletes the audio when "Both" kept the local draft or the transcript could not be saved, so Transcribe again still works. - "Both" and Gemini summaries: long calls no longer give up after a minute; Gemini now gets up to 10 minutes to reply.

## Changes
- Action items: marking an item Urgent no longer moves it to the top of its section; it stays where it was, with its red Urgent mark.

## Changes
- Action items: add your own items with New Action Item, either on their own ("Added by you", listed under the day you added them, counted as yours) or to one of your calls. They get due dates, Urgent and Send to Reminders like the rest. - Action items: add an item someone else owns to Mine, from its row's Mine mark or its context menu, or add all of a call's items at once with "Add All from This Call to Mine". The item keeps its owner, and Mine, the Dashboard tile and the menu bar count it. - Reminders: urgent items no longer get High priority (!!!). Apple doesn't let apps set Reminders' own Urgent, so turn it on in Reminders; the due time still arrives as an alert. - Calls: a recording that ended without a Stop (Ahoy quit or crashed mid-call) now shows how long its audio is, instead of the time until Ahoy was next opened. Calls already affected are corrected at launch.
